# Endorsements
Below is a partial list of the endorsements I have received from the Orinda Community. Note: titles are for identification use only.
### Elected Officials' Endorsements
Janet Riley brings not just years, but decades of service to Orinda. I’ve had the privilege to work
with Janet on many critical issues affecting our schools and community and I’ve seen firsthand
her thoughtful, results-oriented approach to getting things done. I’m proud to support her
reelection to the Orinda City Council.
Pat Rudebusch Former President, OUSD; Orinda Books Owner
I've known Janet for many years and have watched her expertly continue her community service
on the Orinda City Council. Her outstanding skills and passionate community volunteerism are
great assets to the council and our community. Please join me in voting for the reelection of
Janet Riley to the Orinda City Council.
Sue Severson Former Mayor of Orinda; Citizen of the Year 2004
Building on her 30 years of leadership in Orinda on school and community issues, Janet Riley
has expertly served Orinda on the City Council. She brings compassion, top leadership skills,
common sense, and collaboration to the Council, promoting an environment of civic
improvement and volunteerism. I strongly endorse Janet for reelection.

### Community Endorsements
I cannot speak highly enough about Janet Riley. She is an exceptionally talented, bright, hardworking, common-sense leader who has spent her adult life volunteering for Orinda in many different ways. I have worked for and with her on school boards and on many other service projects. She is a neighbor, mother to my kids' friends, was the Girl Scout leader for my daughter and has been a friend for more than 20 years. Janet is highly qualified to serve on the City Council and Orinda is being well cared for under her tenure. We are lucky have her!
Sarah Albo
I am proud to endorse Janet Riley for reelection to the Orinda City Council. Janet is smart, thoughtful, collaborative, and deeply committed to our community. She listens, does her homework, and gets things done. Most importantly, I trust her judgment and know she will continue to work hard for Orinda.
Carol Brovelli
I am proud to endorse Janet Riley for Orinda City Council. I have known Janet for 50 years and have seen firsthand the integrity, intelligence, and dedication she brings to everything she does. Over the years, Janet and I worked together in a number of nonprofit roles supporting Orinda schools, including serving as presidents of EFO, the predecessor to ONE. Janet has always been someone who steps up, listens carefully, works collaboratively, and is deeply committed to the community she serves. Orinda has benefited enormously from Janet’s many years of service, and I have great respect for both her judgment and her character. I am delighted to support her candidacy for City Council.
Karen Derr Gilbert
As President of the Educational Foundation of Orinda (now ONE), Janet worked tirelessly to
advance the high quality of public schools in Orinda and to broaden EFO’s funding base to
insure its long-term financial stability. She brings that same commitment and passion to the City
Council. Janet addresses challenges directly and dives into the details, and her voice and
viewpoint improve the policy results. We strongly recommend Janet’s re-election to the Orinda
City Council.
Steve Harwood, Alison Holland, Karen Derr Gilbert, Joan Kiekhaefer, Yosh Neugebauer, Cara Hoxie, Dean Burnick Past Presidents of the Educational Foundation of Orinda
I have known Janet since college days.
She has consistently proved to be a hard-working, community oriented, forward thinking, socially aware person.
I give her my strongest endorsement in her reelection bid for Orinda City Council.
Ellen Griffith
We are endorsing Janet Riley for her re-election to the Orinda City Council. Her long record of
hard work as a volunteer was publicly attested by her being honored in 2018 as Citizen of the
Year. We know her most for her dedication to our local schools while serving as a president of
EFO (now called One Orinda). Our two children benefited greatly from her efforts. Her strong
work ethic and experience will serve her well when she is re-elected on November 3.
Goldee Gross & Charles Sprague
Paula and I are happy to endorse Janet Riley for her re-election to the Orinda City Council. We
have known Janet and her family for over 25 years and know she will continue to be a dedicated and trustworthy city council member.
Sandy Gross & Paula Reinman
Keep up the good work. I support your candidacy!
Phoebe Kahl
As a 45-year resident and 33-year member of Orinda Garden Club, Janet combines a deep
respect for Orinda's history with a vision that retains its character and charm while addressing
the growing need for revitalization and housing. Janet is an ethical, reasonable, and proven
leader, and we are pleased to endorse her reelection to Orinda City Council.
Lisa Kovalik, Kathy Fernbacher, Laurie Goetzl, Laura Sawczuk, Linda Thompson, Jane Wiser, Cathleen Sodos, Margie Murphy, Pat Winther, Heather Dunne Presidents of the Orinda Garden Club, Past and Present
I can’t think of anybody better to represent Orindans than Janet Riley! She’s exceptionally smart, energetic, and committed. Go Janet!
Mitch Reed
We fully support Janet Riley for re-election. Janet is a fierce supportive of Orinda and has a fair and thoughtful approach. We’re thankful to have her in our community!
Carla Sparolini
Janet is committed and determined to work toward a better Orinda. I endorse Janet Riley for Orinda City Council.
